headline: Avengers: Doomsday eyeing Spider-Man box office records
post:
Spider-Man: Brand New Day dominated the box office this summer and became the highest grossing movie domestically. But according to projections from Box Office Theory, Avengers: Doomsday is reportedly tracking for a massive opening weekend that could potentially out-earn Brand New Day and break its domestic records. 🍿

With Robert Downey Jr., Chris Evans, and the original X-Men appearing in the film, Marvel Studios is setting Doomsday up to best Brand New Day in myriad ways. Will Doomsday take the crown? 

#AvengersDoomsday #SpiderManBrandNewDay #Marvel
original_title: Major Spider-Man: Brand New Day Record Already in Trouble Thanks to Doomsday

headline: Silvermane's Origin Rewritten in Marvel Comic
post:
Hey comic fans! Marvel just dropped a major surprise for everyone following New York's gritty street-level underworld. According to Screen Rant, a recent comic introduces a massive twist to the background of a classic Spider-Man and Punisher villain. 

In the pages of "Predator vs the Punisher" by Frank Tieri and Jesús Saíz, a flashback reveals that a young Silvermane witnessed his criminal father getting killed by a Yautja warrior. The alien predator reportedly repeated his father's words, "don't look away," leaving lasting childhood trauma. 

This completely shakes up how we look at the mob boss's early days before he tangled with Frank Castle and Peter Parker. What do you think of this wild new sci-fi twist? 👽

#Punisher #MarvelComics #SpiderMan
original_title: Marvel Rewrites A Major Character's Origin With New Punisher Retcon

headline: DCU Petition for Gunn and Safran Surges Past 200,000
post:
A new Change.org petition to reinstate James Gunn and Peter Safran as co-heads of DC Studios has passed 201,000 signatures since launching in November. This total is nearly three times the number gathered by the #RestoreTheSnyderverse petition since January 2021.

While the petition likely will not impact Skydance and David Ellison, supporters are making their voices heard about the DCU.

What are your thoughts on this major audience milestone for James Gunn?

#DCU #JamesGunn #DCStudios
original_title: DCU Change.org Petition to Reinstate Gunn & Safran Reaches a Big Milestone, & It’s 3x #RestoreTheSnyderverse

headline: Iman Vellani names the ultimate X-Men story
post:
Kamala Khan actress Iman Vellani is currently co-hosting Marvel's "Countdown to Avengers: Doomsday" podcast. During the "X-Men" episode, she shared her love for the 1982 graphic novel "X-Men: God Loves, Man Kills," calling it the purest distillation of what the characters represent.

Vellani praised the story for exploring how religious beliefs can become dangerous. What is your absolute favorite X-Men comic book story of all time?

headline: Clayface director addresses DC Studios exit
post:
Big news is shaking up the DCU right now! According to Screen Rant, James Gunn and Peter Safran are reportedly ending their time as co-CEOs at DC Studios after four years in those roles.

Clayface filmmaker James Watkins recently spoke about the major DC Studios shake-up in an exclusive chat. The director shared that he had a "really, really good time working with James and Peter", adding that they provided strong support and creative freedom.

While they are stepping down from running the studio, Gunn and Safran will continue in creative roles. Projects like the Man of Tomorrow movie and The People V. Gorilla Grodd are currently moving forward in post-production. 🎬

What are your thoughts on this DC Studios news?

#DCStudios #Clayface #JamesGunn
original_title: James Gunn & Peter Safran's DC Exit Officially Addressed By Clayface Director

headline: Superman's weirdest 1960s comic adventures sold
post:
A vintage collection of twenty-six Superman comic issues recently sold on Heritage for $317.20. The books feature some of the more unusual stories from the Kryptonian's history, including Perry White asking him to perform stunts for local newspaper editions and Supergirl attempting to find him a match.

Additional issues showcase the introduction of a superpowered horse originally cursed as an ancient Greek centaur, as well as simulations by Jor-El exploring how Kal-El might have developed super speed on another planet.

Further details will be provided as they become available.

#Entertainment #Hollywood #PopCulture
original_title: Superman Became the Flash in One of These Bizarre Silver Age Stories, and That’s Just the Beginning
